//: Brisbane River Golf Club (formerly Karana Downs), 212 College Rd, Karana Downs. The fully-OSM-absent case from the add-play-course skill: OpenStreetMap holds ONE partial boundary way (still tagged name=Karana Downs Golf Course, note='Partial boundary ... will leave it till later') and the clubhouse building. No golf=hole, no greens, tees, fairways, bunkers or water. So every green and tee below is placed off open Esri/QLD aerial imagery, with the club's own course map used only for topology (which corridor is which hole), and the fairways + dogleg centrelines are traced from the same imagery by gap-fill's traceFairways.
//card: Scorecard is the club's BlueGolf card (user-supplied screenshot, Aug 2026): par 66 (out 32 / in 34), Black 5158 and Red 4590, men's and women's stroke index identical, a clean 1-18 permutation on the usual front-evens / back-odds convention. The distances are YARDS, not metres -- the club's published Black rating of 65.0 for par 66 is only consistent with ~4,720 m; a 5,158 METRE par-66 course would rate about 68. The tees below are therefore the card yards converted to metres.
//si: One oddity worth knowing before trusting it on the course: the card gives hole 8 (a 165 m par 3) stroke index 2 and hole 9 (a 407 m par 4) stroke index 18. That is the reverse of what the lengths suggest, but it is what the club publishes, so it is baked as printed rather than second-guessed. Replace if the club's own card disagrees.
//ratings: Black CR 65.0 / Slope 116 are the club's published Black figures. The Red tee's own rating could not be verified, so its teeSet carries null cr/slope and courseHandicap falls back to the course figures for it.
